name: onetouchswitch-bridge
summary: Provider/partner settlement backend for onetouchswitch.com (OTS back office; never in the consumer journey), built from Blockchain Lab blocks: Chainlink GBP/USD, stablecoin payout rails, live USDC payout cost in GBP, OFAC payout-address screening, healthy RPC, payout receipt checks, OTS sitemap search. Typed JS client, MCP server and a CORS static JSON API on Pages.

entrypoints.name: GET /v1/{gbp-usd,payout-rails,payout-cost,rpc,sanctioned-evm,ots-pages,provenance,index}.json
entrypoints.usage: catalogue of every endpoint; refreshed every 3 h

entrypoints.name: OTSBridge (JS client)
entrypoints.usage: import { OTSBridge } from 'onetouchswitch-bridge'; await new OTSBridge().gbpUsd()

inputs.name: address
inputs.description: 0x address or ENS name to screen for a payout

inputs.name: tx hash
inputs.description: payout transaction on Base or Ethereum

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: words to find in onetouchswitch.com URLs

outputs.name: gbp_usd
outputs.description: Chainlink GBP/USD rate, round, update time

outputs.name: payout_cost
outputs.description: network cost of a 1 USDC payout in ETH/USD/GBP

outputs.name: screen
outputs.description: BLOCK | PASS_OFAC_ONLY decision with list provenance

compatible_with.how: onchain helpers (evmFees, prices, decodeTx, resolveEns, checkAddress) + toolLinks
deep links for address / tx / approvals inspection
detect.js parses explorer URLs in the receipt checker (demo)
provenance: AggregatorV3Interface located in the chainlink-evm fork
chainlink-price-feed starter is the on-chain counterpart of gbpUsd()
